headline: Reeling Michigan State seeks upset bid at ranked Alabama
subhead: Two-loss Spartans visit Crimson Tide defense after close loss to USC.

xFactor.why: Michigan State's quarterback must limit negative plays and sustain drives against an Alabama defense that just survived Boston College in a one-point game.

keyMatchup: Alabama's pass rush versus Michigan State's offensive line will determine whether the Spartans can establish rhythm and keep their defense off the field.
body: Michigan State arrives in South Carolina searching for any momentum after dropping a tight contest to USC. The Spartans are ranked but winless, and that gap between preseason expectations and field reality creates pressure. Alabama, meanwhile, escaped Boston College with a one-point margin, suggesting a defense still finding its footing despite the ranking.

The decisive factor will be ball security and tempo. Michigan State cannot afford the kind of stalled drives that have haunted them through two weeks, while Alabama's defense needs one complete performance to validate its top-10 status. This is exactly the kind of trap game where a hungry two-loss team can make noise, but Alabama's home field and defensive depth should prove the difference in a low-scoring affair.
